description: Make a PDF of another kind: quote (estimate with valid-until date), receipt (marked Paid), certificate (completion or award, with signatures) or letter (offer letters, notices). Pass the type and its fields; quotes and receipts take the same fields as render_invoice. Returns a PDF link. Costs 2 credits.

fields.description: quote/receipt: same as render_invoice, plus valid_until or valid_days (quote) and paid_date, payment_method (receipt). certificate: title, recipient, reason, kicker, presented, signatures [{name, role}], date, id. letter: from {name, address}, to {name, address}, subject, body (paragraphs split by blank lines), closing, signer, signer_role, date.

name: render_document
title: Make a quote, receipt, certificate or letter PDF
